name: Maid in Grisaille
storyline:
Victorian era, 1850

We play as Prim, a girl sold by her parents to a dark estate, the home of a powerful cult. Her fate as a powerless servant awaits her: hard, dirty work until her death. But she's not ready to give up! She will fight for freedom, exploring the estate and secretly gathering everything she needs. However, the most difficult obstacle isn't the walls, but her own heart. For the path to freedom lies through the masters of the house—five mysterious men, their faces hidden behind hoods. Their charm captivates us, confusing our thoughts and disrupting our plans. And no matter how drawn we are to them, we must remember that they are all bad people.
summary: A 2D dating sim in the dark romance genre, aimed at a female audience.
